headline: Executive order sets sustainability planning goals for federal government operations over roughly the next ten years.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs federal agencies to plan for more sustainable operations over the coming decade. No summary was provided, so specific targets, deadlines, and requirements cannot be confirmed from the available material.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies are expected to plan and carry out sustainability efforts in how they run their operations.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 19, 2015; the specific effective date of provisions is not stated in the source material.
